card.title: Nintendo Switch Motherboard Top Side Component Identification

claims.statement: The motherboard features an NVIDIA ODNX02-A2 SoC, Samsung K4F6E304HB-MGCH DRAM, Broadcom/Cypress BCM4356 wireless IC, Maxim Integrated MAX77621AEWI+T buck regulator, and M92T36 power management IC.
claims.evidence: Annotated top side view of the motherboard and accompanying text list.

card.caveats: The image shows component locations and identification but does not provide voltage, resistance, or diode measurements.
